09/29/2006: Station Maintenance: (bn): 
 
            - Recent battery change did not solve the power interruption 
              problems with the Fremont datalogger.   This morning at 
              9:35am, the datalogger was replaced with a new unit. 
 
 
 
09/22/2006: Station Maintenance: (bn): 
 
            - Power Adjustments (hopefully will correct power issues 
              that recently introduced faulty/missing data at stations 
              such as at Fremont):  [Work done: ~ 11:00] 
 
            - Cell-IP modem now uses external solid-state relay 
              (SW12) instead of internal switched circuit. 
    
            - solid-state relay (SW) connected to terminals inside 
              the power supply instead of the wiring panel. 
 
            - datalogger battery replaced.

04/18/2002: Maintenance (jaa, jtb): 
 
            - Replaced Wind Sentry (Wind Vane/Anemometer): 
 
                Wind vane was broken off of the wind sentry at some point  
                during the winter.  Looking at the data, this appears to  
                have occurred on Dec 05, 2001 at 21:00 EST.  New wind sentry 
                installed with anemometer toward the south and wind vane 
                toward the north.  Marked the following data as missing: 
 
                   Hourly Wind Direction: 12/05/01:2100 - 04/18/02:1000 
 
 
            - Reinstalled Soil Moisture Probes (horizontally under sod): 
 
                   Soil Moisture A: 10 cm 
                   Soil Moisture B: 25 cm 
 
              Reinstalling the soil moisture probes introduced errors in  
              the following variables and report times - marked the following 
              as missing:: 
 
                  Soil Moisture A:             04/18/02 (day=108) - 10:00 
                  Soil Moisture B:             04/18/02 (day=108) - 10:00 
                  Soil Moisture A:             04/18/02 (day=108) - 11:00 
                  Soil Moisture B:             04/18/02 (day=108) - 11:00 
 
                  Max Soil Moisture A:         04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
                  Time of Max Soil Moisture A: 04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
                  Min Soil Moisture A:         04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
                  Time of Min Soil Moisture A: 04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
 
                  Max Soil Moisture B:         04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
                  Time of Max Soil Moisture B: 04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
                  Min Soil Moisture B:         04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
                  Time of Min Soil Moisture B: 04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
 
 
            - Herbicide applied over soil temperatures (SW quadrant)

09/07/2001: Phone Line Troubles: 
   
            - Phone switch has died once again.  Decided to bypass 
              switch with use of separate, dedicated phone line for  
              weather station.  New phone line will be ordered. 
 
 
 
08/24/2001: Data Cleanup: 
 
            - Wind Vane was found off the wind sentry mount.  Looking at  
              the data, it appears that the wind vane was off since Fri. 
              August 24, 2001 - 4:00am.  Instrument was reinstalled by 
              Jim Breinling on Tue. August 28, 2001 - 11:05am. 
 
              The following modifications to the raw datafile were made 
              to cleanup the faulty data: 
 
                 Hourly Data:   Marked as missing (-6999) the following: 
 
                                    08/24/01 (day=236), time=0400 
                                       thru 
                                    08/28/01 (day=240). time=1100

                                          thru

                                          05/15/01 (135) = 47.24mm (+10.41mm) 
                                          05/16/01 (136) =  9.65mm (+ 3.30mm) 
                                          05/17/01 (137) =  0.00mm (-13.72mm) 
 
 
 
05/17/2001: Precipitation Gauge Maintenance:  
 
            - Funnel of Tipping Bucket Rain Gauge Was Clogged.  Jim  
              Breinling of MSU Extension cleared the problem at 1:40pm. 
 
            - Precipitation values from recent rain events are 
              inaccurate and will need to be modified (see below)

10/30/2000: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
                 
            - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=303, Time=200. 
 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
              from Day=303, Time=200 through Day=304, Time=1930. 
              Only Observation Times were modified, not times of 
              Maxs and Mins.  Users will need to take that into 
              consideration when using this data. 
 
 
 
08/01/2000:  Wind Sentry Rotated 180-degrees to correct data that was 
             being reported.  Now Wind Sentry is installed opposite of 
             normal with anemomter facing north and wind vane facing 
             south. 
 
             Inspection of faulty phone line/modem.  Determined that 
             COMM SWITCH has failed.  Connecting a direct phone line  
             (bypassing switch) to the datalogger allows modem to pick  
             up.  Switch left at site until replacement or dedicated 
             phoneline is installed. 
 
             Field Technician: Tom Cate
